name: Executive Audience
description: Senior decision-makers such as C-suite executives, directors, and senior managers responsible for strategic decisions

characteristics.knowledge_level: Broad understanding of business concepts, varied technical depth
characteristics.expectations: Strategic insights, clear business impact, and actionable recommendations
characteristics.typical_objections: Questions about ROI, strategic alignment, and resource implications

content.depth: High-level with the option to dive deeper if requested
content.evidence: Business metrics, case studies, and clear outcomes
content.logical_flow: Bottom line up front, then supporting details

engagement_strategies: Frame information in terms of business impact
Connect to strategic initiatives and priorities
Include relevant market context and competitive positioning
communication_pitfalls: Too much technical detail without business context
Not providing clear recommendations or next steps
Missing links to current business priorities

effective_approaches.opening: Clear executive summary with business impact highlighted
effective_approaches.structure: Pyramid principle - conclusion first, then supporting points
effective_approaches.examples: Case studies with measurable business outcomes
effective_approaches.handling_questions: Direct, business-focused responses with strategic context

ceo_coo.approach: Broader business context and long-term implications

cfo.approach: More emphasis on ROI and financial metrics

cto_cio.approach: Balance of technical and business perspectives
